notes.title: Multiplayer on the way!
notes.content:
Greetings pilot, your drone awaits your orders! Have you overcome many obstacles with your drone and do you like challenges? Until today you could have played  to get better time and tried to overcome your score. But now there’s a new challenge - fighting with other pilots who will do their best to get their drones to the finish!

[u]What may you look forward to?[/u]

[list]
[*] Multiplayer online
[*] LAN support
[*] Split Screen
[*] Chat
[/list]

What does it all mean? Just take the controller and start to train so you can beat your opponents because they’ll have no mercy with your drone and they will try to finish the game before you do.
